roles: N when a preregistered alternative survives
question: How do source geometry, explicit molecular encounters, and the mobility and population of the two conformations shape material concentration in an initially unstructured 3D exclusion fluid?
registration_scope: Prior studies and their published summaries informed these choices. This specifies the new execution and analysis before any new research histories. The historical v02 run files and the earlier explicit-fuel run files were unavailable in this checkout.

fuel_discovery.selection: all registered N24/T300 cases and seeds

fuel_grid.selection: all registered N24/T300 slots with exact recipe reuse from this execution of discovery

lattice_brackets.selection: all registered concentrations, mobilities and seeds, following the matched dynamic runs

parameters.declaration: Use the existing local Hamiltonian, passive and reversible driven pathways, and reservoir rules. Species, energies, mobilities, density, composition controls and the aperture geometry are placed at time zero.

observations.window_mean: Trapezoidal time average including endpoints. Interpolate only between bracketing recorded samples at a window endpoint; retain all raw frame measurements and report the cadence.
observations.primary: Width-4 periodic coarse macromolecule density variance; paired signed differences at matched seed/volume/time. Report width 2 and the frozen thresholds 0.3, 0.5, 0.7 as sensitivity readouts.
secondary: net passive and driven reaction directions, measured chemical work and source exchanges
x-profiles and variance in x-only modes vs within transverse planes
contact propensities measured directly from the state, with nonmacro-site mean mixing and same-x reduced controls
periodic six-neighbor component size and winding via displacement constraints across faces
observations.pairing: Record all signed per-seed differences and seed ranges; use matched same-window prefixes for duration and fixed same-duration comparisons for physical volume. A frame, a reused grid slot or a shared prefix is not an independent replicate.
observations.lattice_composition: At each seed and matched D_I, bracket the active high-df late B fraction by the adjacent frozen B proportions, using realized integer populations. Report active minus linearly interpolated null and active position relative to BOTH endpoints. Outside range means unavailable; interpolation summarizes the bracket and does not assert monotone behavior between knots.
observations.interpretations: Directional consistency across six holdouts is descriptive. Evaluate off-source structure, cycling and composition jointly. An aperture-aligned pattern, positive reaction counts, greater coarse variance or a winding component each admit non-vessel explanations.
observations.reversibility: Compare fed vs closed and passive-on vs passive-off using the exact source, stoichiometry and affinity ledgers. Passive-off has an effective equilibrium energy df+mu and can sustain dense regions at equilibrium. Initial fuel imbalance is a placed finite resource in the closed arms.

integrity.validation: Run the existing reference, sparse and mobility instrument suites first. Validate periodic translation invariance, winding and independently enumerated encounter totals before interpretation.
integrity.fail_rule: Retain any failed history and its inputs. Preserve all solver samples and four full state arrays in per-history archives. Report incompleteness visibly. Do not change physical parameters in response to any individual result.
integrity.limits: Molecular lattice, finite physical volume and time, ideal bath and hypothetical energies, implicit solvent, no hydrodynamics. Resolve total macromolecule density and modeled chemical work. A material membrane, inheritance, life or formal ladder promotion requires independent evidence.
no_touch: all earlier research histories and code
integrity.qualification: Keep the standing three-distinct-vessel-findings contract. Known checks, parameter variants of one mechanism and placed chemistry do not fill it.
